mapper.select: SELECT body, fetched_at FROM od_cache WHERE cache_key = #{key}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO od_cache (cache_key, body, fetched_at) VALUES (#{key}, #{body}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE body = VALUES(body), fetched_at = VALUES(fetched_at)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meta_scan WHERE match_id = #{matchId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO meta_scan (match_id, scanned_at) VALUES (#{matchId}, NOW())

INSERT IGNORE INTO meta_build (match_id, hero_id, win, avg_rank_tier, start_time, duration, items, first_buys) VALUES (#{matchId}, #{heroId}, #{win}, #{avgRankTier}, #{startTime}, #{duration}, #{items}, #{firstBuys})
